title: STREET YEET
description: Walk a low-poly city block and send anyone, anything, a hilariously unrealistic distance with one swing of a gigantic hammer.
controls: WASD or arrow keys to walk, Shift to run
Mouse to look around (click to grab the mouse), Q and E to turn the camera
Click or Space to swing; hold to charge a bigger yeet
On touch screens, drag left to walk, drag right to look, and hold YEET to charge
